Sidecars written by ART 1.26.7 (macOS), unedited. Each started from a hand-written sidecar (see scripts/make-xmp-kit.sh) except `created`.

| File | Action in ART | Started from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `created-3star-red.xmp` | rate 3 stars, label Red | no sidecar (ART created `<stem>.xmp`) |
| `cleared-0star-nolabel.xmp` | clear stars and label | 5 stars, Green |
| `trash-minus1-red.xmp` | Move to trash | 3 stars, Red |
| `edited-5star-yellow.xmp` | 5 stars, label Yellow | 3 stars, label `red` (lowercase) |

Develop settings (exposure, crop) go to `<name>.<ext>.arp`, never into the `.xmp`.
